title: Mochizuki Honami — Daydreams For The Future〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Study Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll leave the guides regarding what's going to be covered on each test right here just in case.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks. Oh...
All the important parts are highlighted. This makes things so easy to see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Speaking of which, these tests are gonna cover more stuff than normal, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it also sounds like the problems will be more basic. That may make things easier than we're used to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That'd be nice, but we can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we want a chance at perfect scores, then we gotta be able to nail all of the applied-knowledge problems!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm also still struggling with those...
I'll need to get better at them in time for the test.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Anyway, we've probably talked enough.
Let's start studying, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... We have to head over to the studio later today, so... I'll be sure to remind you all again in two hours.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Hona! Alright, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I'm starting to feel a little tired...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the others are maintaining their focus, so I need to keep doing my best.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I was working on this graph problem...
But my calculation seems off for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you talking about this function graph? That's a difficult one, but the real root portion seems right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I recall, the next step involves finding the solution using the discriminant of this function. Why don't we try that together...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does my math look right to you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, everything looks correct...
Including the intermediate steps.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Finally. Thanks for showing me what to do. Your explanation was so easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami, sorry...
Would you mind helping me with this problem for Classical Japanese?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm working on this honorific language part, but I'm not sure about my answers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh, you're so close here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “To receive” here doesn't count as being honorific. Rather, it's a sign of modesty. That distinction lies in...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... I had trouble wrapping my head around this one during class, but everything makes sense now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's the thing about these problems. The key is to know to whom the speaker is referring.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll try applying what you just said to these other problems.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're like a private tutor, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Didn't you say the same thing last time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you really are an amazing teacher, Honami. You'd make studying for tests so easy if you were a private tutor.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I always end up reaching for my bass whenever I try to study at home. You'd probably do a good job getting me to stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, Ms. Hona!
I want you to help me with these really hard problems!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you three...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't really be your private tutor, but I'll be more than happy to teach you what I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, I do love helping all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Now we've got Ms. Hona on speed dial!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It'd be great to have you come by every week.
But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She also needs time to study, so I'll try to solve as many of these problems as I can on my own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You're right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami also has to do other stuff, like corresponding with Mr. Shindo and managing Leo/need's schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. That means we should only call her when we really need her!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't have to mind me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, it is like them to want to do what they can on their own...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll need to stay prepared for when they do require my help.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which means I need to keep on studying...!)
